items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: the minstrel show manager at that time was, we used to call him Green River, but his name was Jewel Weaver... He played a big bass on him. But he was the manager of the show.

ctx.x: Vernon Brothers, that was a carnival show. I've heard Buck Johnson mention he was once with Vernon.

Vernon Brothers, and that was a carnival show, but I was playing in the minstrel show, that was connected with the carnival show. And the minstrel show manager at that time was, we used to call him Green River, but his name was Jewel Weaver, out of Dallas, Texas. We called him Green River. He played a big bass on him. But he was the manager of the show. Well that's my first carnival show, that is under Candace. Vernon Brothers. Well I done lots of traveling with them. Where was their headquarters, Texas? Vernon…
Macon, Georgia. Macon, Georgia, that's Vernon Brothers headquarters. Well from Vernon Brothers I went on to David A. Wise, carnival.
